import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000;
    static final int MAXNODE = 205;

    static int N, T;
    static char[][] firstGrid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] secondGrid = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distFromZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][][][] canFlow = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

    static int[] dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, capacity, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, int capacity, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static int nodeCount, source, sink;
    static int[] level = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] nextEdge = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] queueArr = new int[MAXNODE];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXNODE];

    static void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity) {
        edges.add(new Edge(from, to, capacity, 0));
        adj[from].add(edges.size() - 1);
        edges.add(new Edge(to, from, 0, 0));
        adj[to].add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean makeLevelGraph() {
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        queueArr[tail++] = source;
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[source] = 0;
        while (head < tail && level[sink] == -1) {
            int v = queueArr[head++];
            for (int id : adj[v]) {
                int to = edges.get(id).to;
                if (level[to] == -1 && edges.get(id).flow < edges.get(id).capacity) {
                    queueArr[tail++] = to;
                    level[to] = level[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int v, int pushed) {
        if (pushed == 0) return 0;
        if (v == sink) return pushed;
        for (int i = nextEdge[v]; i < adj[v].size(); ++i) {
            int id = adj[v].get(i);
            int to = edges.get(id).to;
            if (level[to] != level[v] + 1) continue;
            int got = sendFlow(to, Math.min(pushed, edges.get(id).capacity - edges.get(id).flow));
            if (got > 0) {
                edges.get(id).flow += got;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= got;
                return got;
            }
            nextEdge[v] = i + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int answer = 0;
        while (makeLevelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(nextEdge, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = sendFlow(source, INF)) > 0)
                answer += pushed;
        }
        return answer;
    }

    static boolean reachableInTime(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty) {
        if (firstGrid[sx][sy] == 'Y' || firstGrid[sx][sy] == 'Z' ||
            firstGrid[tx][ty] == 'Y' || firstGrid[tx][ty] == 'Z')
            return false;

        int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];

            if (x == tx && y == ty) return true;

            if (dist[x][y] >= T || dist[x][y] >= distFromZ[x][y])
                continue;

            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dr[d], ny = y + dc[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                    firstGrid[nx][ny] != 'Y' && firstGrid[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                    dist[nx][ny] == INF &&
                    dist[x][y] + 1 <= distFromZ[nx][ny]) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume rest of line

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            firstGrid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            secondGrid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        // Initialize distFromZ
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(distFromZ[i], INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                if (firstGrid[x][y] == 'Z') {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nx = x + dr[d], ny = y + dc[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                            firstGrid[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                            distFromZ[nx][ny] = 1;
                            q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dr[d], ny = y + dc[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                    firstGrid[nx][ny] != 'Y' && firstGrid[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                    distFromZ[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    distFromZ[nx][ny] = distFromZ[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        // Precompute canFlow
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; ++x1)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; ++y1)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; ++x2)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; ++y2)
                        canFlow[x1][y1][x2][y2] = reachableInTime(x1, y1, x2, y2);

        // Build flow network
        source = 0;
        sink = 2 * N * N + 1;
        nodeCount = 2 * N * N + 2;

        // Initialize adjacency list
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i)
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (firstGrid[i][j] > '0' && firstGrid[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(source, 1 + i * N + j, firstGrid[i][j] - '0');
                if (secondGrid[i][j] > '0' && secondGrid[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(N * N + 1 + i * N + j, sink, secondGrid[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; ++x1)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; ++y1)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; ++x2)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; ++y2)
                        if (canFlow[x1][y1][x2][y2])
                            addEdge(1 + x1 * N + y1, N * N + 1 + x2 * N + y2, INF);

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
